page_data.en:
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL 8629
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.
23 / 7 38
July 20th 1938.

Sir,
    I have the honour to transmit herein
copies of self-explanatory correspondence
which has passed between His Excellency the
Governor of Hongkong and this Consulate-General
regarding a forged Lithuanian document of
identity and to request that I may be furnished
with a report concerning Mr. Aaron Haikin.

            I have the honour to be,
                Sir,
        Your obedient servant,

            Herbert Phillips

            Consul-General.

The Commissioner of Police,
    Shanghai Municipal Council,
        SHANGHAI.

谨致
